summary: Quoin Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $11.0 million of American Depositary Shares (each ADS representing 35 ordinary shares) through Leerink Partners as sales agent under a Sales Agreement dated November 4, 2026. Leerink receives a 3.0% commission; sales are at-the-market under Rule 415(a)(4) with no escrow. Public float was roughly $33.1 million as of September 8, 2026; the ADS closed at $3.93 on November 3, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and I.B.6 capacity limits.
